2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch introduces a per-CPU stock representation in the page_counter layer, similar to memcg's seven-slot per-CPU stock. It adds a new struct page_counter_stock_pcp that preserves the existing behavior from memcg and includes a backpointer to the base of the percpu stock. The patch also updates the page_counter structure to include pointers to the percpu stock and its owning cgroup_subsys_state. No functional changes are intended in this patch, which is part of a larger series.
